title: SRD 5.1 class primaryAbilities from Multiclassing prerequisites
description:
The base-class parser (loreweaver-0m9.5.2) emits class records with primaryAbilities: [] because the SRD 5.1 'Class Features' block does not print a per-class primary/key ability line — per ADR 0007 the importer leaves the field empty rather than authoring it from model knowledge.

The canonical SRD source for per-class key abilities is the 'Multiclassing' section's prerequisites listing (Barbarian — Strength 13, Fighter — Strength 13 or Dexterity 13, Monk — Dexterity 13 and Wisdom 13, ...). This bead: add a deterministic slice + parser for that listing, build a class-name -> abilities map, and have the class emitter populate primaryAbilities from it. Provenance still cites the source page.

This is a normalization-mapping task (ADR 0007 says a human reviews such mappings). Verify exact section placement/format against the vendored PDF; the Multiclassing section likely falls inside the core-rules slice range (Using Ability Scores .. Spell Lists).
acceptance_criteria:
- A Multiclassing prerequisites parser yields a class-name -> ability list map from the SRD.
- Class records' primaryAbilities are populated from that map (Fighter -> [Strength, Dexterity], Wizard -> [Intelligence], etc.).
- Classes absent from the prerequisites map retain []; no value is authored from model knowledge.
- Unit tests cover an 'or' class (Fighter), an 'and' class (Monk), and a single-ability class (Wizard).
notes: Merged work delivered via PR #124: https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/124 (earlier close reason mistakenly cited #122, which was never created).
close_reason: Implemented via parseMulticlassing slice+parser (class->primaryAbilities map from SRD Multiclassing prerequisites); emit merges into class records, best-effort per ADR 0007. PR #122: https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/122
